name: busybar
description: Draw, show pictures and play sounds on your BUSY Bar.

BUSY_ADDR.title: BUSY Bar or window manager address

WM_API_TOKEN.title: Window manager API token
WM_API_TOKEN.description: Match WM_API_TOKEN on the window manager, if configured.

BUSY_HTTP_PASSWORD.title: HTTP access password
BUSY_HTTP_PASSWORD.description: Only if the Bar has HTTP access locked.

BUSY_TOKEN.title: BUSY cloud token
BUSY_TOKEN.description: From cloud.busy.app/api-tokens, to reach the Bar from anywhere.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: For the GitHub tools. Empty: uses `gh auth token` if the GitHub CLI is logged in.
